done_when: When forge.toml sets test_runner, the generated forge.yml's scheduled full-suite job runs on test_runner; without it, the job runs on runner as today; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade and forge sync

known.title: Keep status-write tokens off pull-request test runners
Gate: nightly runner selection at init and custom runner fallback

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security
Case: normal use - A repo uses a persistent self-hosted `test_runner` for pull requests and a separate GitHub-hosted `runner`. Code from an approved fork PR can persist on the test runner; this change then runs the scheduled job on that same machine with a job-wide token that has `statuses: write` (lines 333–342). The attacker can use it to forge a successful `forge-pr-check` status on a PR, bypassing the review status. GitHub documents both [persistent runner compromise](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/secure-use) and the [status-write API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/commits/statuses). The separate `full-suite-result` job already posts the full-suite status, and `src/forge/fullrun.py:107` skips posting from matrix jobs, so the test job does not need status-write permission.
findings.title: Keep status-write tokens off pull-request test runners

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - A new repo starts with `test_runner` already in `forge.toml`, or an existing repo uses a custom `runner` without `test_runner`. This test checks init only with the default runner, then adds `test_runner` after init; its fallback case also leaves `runner` at `ubuntu-24.04`. The sibling PR-machine test likewise configures `test_runner` only after init and uses the default runner in its only fallback case. Thus an init path that ignored a configured `test_runner`, or a nightly fallback hard-coded to Ubuntu, would pass both proofs. Init accepts existing settings (`src/forge/init.py:403–410`), so the named proof needs to exercise both promised cases.
findings.title: Gate: nightly runner selection at init and custom runner fallback

why: Issue 1660: the generated workflow's scheduled full-suite job runs on runner, not test_runner, so a team cannot send the nightly full suite to its fast runners
